text:
Alex: Heads up - starting marketplace onboarding for AWS / GCP / Azure today. Need to lock roles, trial SKU, KMS requirements, and the asset checklist. Using this thread for cross-team coordination.
Maria: Thanks. Legal has flags: EULA localization, export controls, and a short clause for EU data residency. @Sanjay can you confirm customer-managed KMS support for Private deployments?
Sanjay: Yes - Private supports customer-provided KMS/HSM. For Hosted we expose envelope encryption via partner KMS integration. I'll paste the integration notes here.
Sanjay: Link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/marketplace/kms-integration - TL;DR: IAM policy bindings, key aliasing, rotation window = 90 days, audit logs required.
Alex: Ops-bot reminder?
Ops-bot: Reminder: marketplace-staging account credentials expire in 3 days. Run `aws sts get-caller-identity` to validate before pushing artifacts.
June: Packaging question - should default trial be 14-day credits or a 30-day meter? PM leaning on 14-day credit + clear CTA to upgrade.
Maria: Legal prefers trials not exceed 30 days and wants an explicit refund & data retention blurb. Also need to include an EU data residency checkbox for Azure listing.
Alex: Can we present both options in the store: default 14-day free credits and an enterprise offer with 30-day trial via contract?
Sam: For GCP publisher portal: assets must be <=200MB tarball, hero image 1200x628, square icon 512x512, and include SHA256 in manifest. Also need the OAuth callback URLs and publisher contact email.
Lily: Design will produce hero + icons by EOD Friday and upload to `partnerships-drive`.
Maria: Legal needs the asset checklist + listing copy for TOS/EULA by next Tues. I'll draft EU clause and export control language and share here.
Sanjay: For IAM we should provide an example role ARN in the docs: `arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/RedwoodMarketplacePublisher` - trust policy includes `marketplace.amazonaws.com` and `sts:AssumeRole`. Thoughts?
Ops: No objections. Also include `kms:Encrypt` and `kms:Decrypt` in the role when integrating KMS. Add a note about least-privilege for production.
Alex: Action items summary: Sanjay - KMS + IAM docs and example role ARNs; Lily - produce images and upload; Maria - legal copy + checklist; June - finalize pricing/trial packaging; Sam - GCP manifest details & publisher quotas. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
Maria: I'll post the legal checklist into this thread when ready and tag the ops folks for retention policy.
Alex: Tentative publish window: two-week sprint starting next Monday. If artifacts land by next Wed we can submit on Thurs.
Sam: I'll confirm publisher account quotas and any onboarding steps by EOD today.
Ops-bot: Credential rotate complete - new staging creds posted to vault path `secret/marketplace/staging` (rotated).
Alex: Quick Q: does anyone expect mandatory certifications (SOC2/ISO) to block the initial listings? @Maria
Maria: Not a blocker for initial listing, but SOC2 page should be linked in the listing for enterprise buyers and sales cycles. We'll prepare the pointer.
Alex: Great. Also note: public-facing docs should explicitly call out data handling for Azure EU regions. Will reconcile copy with legal.
Sanjay: I'll add the sample CloudFormation snippet and a minimal `roles.json` example for the publisher instructions:
```
{
  "RoleName": "RedwoodMarketplacePublisher",
  "AssumeRolePolicyDocument": { /* trust for marketplace.amazonaws.com */ }
}
```
Alex: Perfect. Thanks everyone - keeping this as the single source of truth. Please update this thread when your task is done so we can track readiness.
Maria: Uploading draft legal copy now.
Lily: Assets uploaded to `partnerships-drive/marketplace/hero-pack-v1` (png + svg).
Sam: Confirmed GCP manifest schema accepted; sharing manifest and SHA256 in Drive.
Ops: Noted - will run a smoke test in staging after manifest push.
Alex: :spiral_calendar: OK - check-ins Friday and next Wed. Closing the loop here for now.
